sloka: यस्या वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे ।ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ ।सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपवीक्षिता ।। ७.२६.१९ ॥
transliteration: yasyā vaktraṁ śaśinibhaṁ bhruvau cāpanibhe śubhe ।ūrū karikarākārau karau pallavakomalau ।sainyamadhyena gacchantī rāvaṇenopavīkṣitā ।। 7.26.19 ॥

translations.english: Her face was like the moon, her beautiful eyebrows like bows, her thighs like elephant trunks, and her hands soft as new leaves; as she walked through the army, she was observed by Ravana.
